# HEM v0.7.4b2 — Reliable calibration interruption and recovery

- Discards unfinished measurements when calibration is interrupted by a pause, command wait, missing measurement, device availability change, control change or interrupted evaluation. Completed, qualified cycles remain saved. A normal verified ON/OFF transition still contributes to learning; multiple hidden transitions invalidate the unfinished cycle.
- Keeps separate, bounded learning histories for matching device, operating mode, sensor, profile, target and fan contexts. Returning to a previous context restores its accepted cycles. Changing between Adaptive Suggest and Adaptive Auto keeps that history; manually changing PID gains invalidates the affected mode's history.
- Revokes queued automatic adjustments when an interruption or timing change occurs, and checks the current context and settings again before saving. An upstream power controller that is paused, unavailable or awaiting confirmation also blocks calibration writes.
- Expires recommendations after 48 hours or when their gains, timing settings or observed context change. Expired recommendations can be discarded. The existing PID panel and native Approve button now use the same current-state checks, with explanations in English, Greek and German.
- Recovers an approved adjustment saved immediately before a restart or cancellation by matching its exact persisted application receipt. The proposal is shown as Applied without writing the gains a second time. Valid pending proposals survive an ordinary pause or restart and remain subject to the current approval guards.
- Restores pending proposal notifications after interruption and retries failed notification creation or clearing. Learning records are pruned at startup and during maintenance, even without another completed cycle.

Partial measurements are not resumed after a restart. New automatic tuning still requires a newly completed qualifying cycle, suitable model confidence, confirmed safe OFF, the existing daily cooldown and conservative gain limits. Calibration does not force test operation of the appliance.

Update through HACS with beta versions enabled, restart Home Assistant to load the integration, and reload the dashboard to load the updated card.
